---
name: requirements-summary
description: Request a consolidated summary of requirements gathered so far
agent: requirements-gathering
---

Please provide a **consolidated summary** of the application functionality and UX requirements we've gathered.

Organize the output under:
- **1.1 Core Features** - primary functions, critical vs. future prioritization
- **1.2 User Flows** - user types, interactions, automation candidates
- **1.3 UX/UI Considerations** - design tools, systems, guidelines, accessibility, localization, devices


Use the matching saved engineering run. Persist captured answers using the shared requirements procedure; summaries must show recorded facts, assumptions, and unanswered questions. Follow existing user preferences for external sources and diagrams.
